lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works with Coconut Grove businesses on SEO, social media, paid advertising, websites and video. The Grove is one of the oldest neighbourhoods in the City of Miami, a leafy bayfront village of boutiques, restaurants, studios, marinas and small offices with a loyal residential base. Businesses here grow through regulars and reputation, so we focus on marketing that keeps you visible to neighbours and gives weekend visitors a reason to choose you.

sections.heading: A village inside the city
paragraphs: The centre of the Grove is compact and walkable. CocoWalk, Main Highway, Grand Avenue and McFarlane Road hold most of the shops, cafes and restaurants, and Peacock Park opens onto the bay at the foot of the hill. Along the water, Dinner Key and the sailing clubs make this a base for boat owners, sailing schools and marine trades. Vizcaya Museum and Gardens and The Barnacle Historic State Park draw visitors, and several well-known private schools bring families through the neighbourhood every weekday.

The business mix follows from that. Independent boutiques, restaurants with terraces, yoga and Pilates studios, salons, vets, architects, interior designers, estate agents and small professional practices dominate.

sections.heading: Regulars first, visitors second
paragraphs: Residents are the core customers: families and long-time homeowners who walk or cycle to the village and prefer to buy locally. Next come people from nearby Coral Gables, Brickell and Key Biscayne, who drive over for dinner, brunch or a class. Weekend visitors and tourists on their way to or from Vizcaya add a third layer, particularly in the cooler months.

Because so much trade is repeat business, retention matters as much as reach. An email list, a simple loyalty offer and an Instagram account that shows what is new this week often return more than broad advertising.
bullets: A Google Business Profile with current hours, menu or service list and photos that show the terrace, the shopfront or the studio.
Pages that use the names people search by: Coconut Grove, the Grove, CocoWalk, Main Highway, Dinner Key.
Parking and arrival details on your site, since finding a space is the main complaint of anyone driving in.
Small-radius ads for residents, widened at weekends to nearby neighbourhoods.

sections.heading: Homes, boats and the services around them
paragraphs: The Grove's houses sit under a dense tree canopy, many of them older or architect-designed, and owners invest in them. Architects, landscape designers, arborists, contractors, pool services and interior designers find steady work here, and homeowners choose on the strength of a portfolio and a neighbour's word. A website with well-photographed local projects and a clear description of what you take on does more than any advertisement.

On the water, charter operators, sailing schools, boat mechanics and brokers serve owners and visitors, who search for a specific service near Dinner Key and book when a page shows prices and availability.

sections.heading: Festival weekends and quiet summers
paragraphs: The cooler months are the busy ones, when terraces fill and visitors are in town. The Coconut Grove Arts Festival over Presidents' Day weekend in February brings the largest crowds of the year to the bayfront streets, and regattas on Biscayne Bay fill the marinas through the winter sailing season. The King Mango Strut parade and the Goombay Festival, which celebrates the neighbourhood's Bahamian heritage, are local fixtures. Summer is slower, as many families travel once school ends, and hurricane season keeps marine and tree services busy with preparation.

faqs.q: Is Coconut Grove its own city?
faqs.a: No. Coconut Grove is a neighbourhood of the City of Miami, though it has a strong identity of its own. People search for it by name, so your listings and pages should say Coconut Grove as well as Miami.

faqs.q: How can a small shop in Coconut Grove compete online?
faqs.a: Concentrate on the people nearest to you. Keep your business profile and reviews strong, post what is new on social media, build an email list of regulars and give visitors a way to buy from you online once they have gone home.

faqs.q: Does TDM have anyone local to Coconut Grove?
faqs.a: A member of our team is based in Miami. We work with Grove businesses remotely, with calls and written updates.

faqs.q: What does it cost to hire a marketing agency for a Coconut Grove business?
faqs.a: The price depends on the work involved, which for a small business may be a focused plan on one or two channels. We quote after a free consultation.
